title: The Salary Negotiation Script That Works Even If You're Introverted
script: Most salary negotiation advice is built for extroverts. 'Go in person. Command the room. Make eye contact.' If that makes you want to disappear, this is for you. I'm about to give you a salary negotiation script that works — in writing. Three emails. No awkward meetings. No anxiety. Email one: the opener. You send this to your manager: 'Hi [Name], I'd like to discuss my compensation. I've been researching market rates for this role and I'd like to schedule some time to talk.' That's it. No apology, no justification. Email two: the anchor. This is where you name your number. 'Based on my research into similar roles at this level, I'm targeting [salary].' Don't apologize. Don't overjustify. The research is your armor. Email three: the close. When they come back with a counter-offer: 'Thank you for this. I'm excited about this offer. I'm looking for [your number] to finalize.' Written negotiation works because 95% of candidates never send these emails. You stand out by being strategic, not loud. Drop 'NEGOTIATE' in the comments and I'll DM you all three scripts.
